_readme: Your own endpoints for the ✨🧠 LLM Request node. Copied to UserEndpoints.json on first run; that copy is git-ignored and survives updates. Entries here are added to the built-in list; one with the same name as a built-in replaces it, and "enabled": false hides it. Never paste keys or private addresses here: put them in the .env file in the pack root and reference them as ${VAR}. Press R in ComfyUI (refresh node definitions) after editing.

endpoints.name: My llama.cpp box
endpoints.description: Example entry. Set "enabled": true to show it in the node.

endpoints.name: CLI Proxy API
endpoints.description: A local https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI instance, wrapping subscription logins (Gemini, Grok, Claude Code, Codex...) as an OpenAI-compatible server. Third-party tool that holds those account credentials - only run it on a machine you trust. Set "enabled": true to show it in the node.
